Nations League round-up: England and Spain win, Scotland trounced by Swiss

Updated / Tuesday, 29 Sep 2026 22:11

Anthony Gordon and Harry Kane secured England a straightforward 2-0 win away to 10-man Czechia at the end of one of the most dramatic days in the nation's footballing history.

Nico O’Reilly missed Tuesday’s trip to Czechia through injury but Man City team-mates Marc Guehi and Elliot Anderson had the chance to park Tuesday's blockbuster news in an ultimately comfortable Nations League win.

Pavel Sulc’s first-half sending off after a VAR review of his clumsy challenge on Anderson took the sting out of the initially lively hosts and Gordon gave Thomas Tuchel’s men a deserved lead early in the second half.

The forward headed home a fantastic cross by Trent Alexander-Arnold, who was making his first start under the German coach, before skipper Kane slammed home to settle any nerves.

New Scotland boss Sebastien Pocognoli endured a demoralising Hampden debut as his 10-man side were dismantled 3-0 by sure-footed Switzerland.

Just over a month after being appointed as Steve Clarke's successor, the 39-year-old Belgian’s big night got off to the worst possible start as Jack Hendry was sent off early on for denying a goal-scoring opportunity.

Ricardo Rodriguez fired home the resulting free-kick and the Swiss went on to dominate the remainder of the match, with further goals after the break from Nico Elvedi and Zeki Amdouni.

With just one point and no goals from their opening two Nations League fixtures, Scotland must now rouse themselves for Saturday night’s match in North Macedonia as their new boss bids to get his reign up and running.

Elsewhere, Spain had too much for Croatia in their League A clash in Seville. Lamine Yamal opened the scoring just two minutes in before Dion Beljo equalised for the Croats.

That was as good as it got for the visitors however as Marc Pubill restored Spain's lead within two minutes. Yamal struck again shortly after the hour mark with Nico Williams getting a fourth late on, to secure a second win on the bounce.

Slovenia defeated North Macedonia in the only League B fixture of the night, as goals from Sandi Lovric and Aljosa Matko moved them into second place, following an opening night draw with Scotland.

In Group C1, Finland and Belarus drew 0-0 while Albania won 3-0 in San Marino.

Moldova were held to a 1-1 draw at home to the Faroe Islands and Slovakia beat Kazakhstan 2-1 in Group C3 while in C4, Iceland were 3-0 winners in Luxembourg and Estonia drew 1-1 in Bulgaria.
